command: Extend gemmini_descriptor_sequencer using generated expected vectors in this fixed order: multi-tile OS, LOOP_WS, Conv 1x1/3x3, optional bias chain, then output requant and ReLU/ReLU6. Cache and validate src0/src1/dst/bias before issue; derive tiling and local addresses exactly from the pinned Gemmini C path. Bind every build/test to CPU 8-25 and start only above 10 GiB MemAvailable.
success_condition: For every legal production descriptor, funct/rs1/rs2 and issue count equal the frozen Python/pinned-C transcript; all illegal or incomplete chains issue zero CUSTOM_3; busy completion, event, write trace and output hash remain exact under randomized backpressure.
failure_policy: Stop at the first transcript or numerical mismatch. Do not expose local Gemmini addresses in the public ISA, bypass typed descriptors, pre-lower on the host, use io_resp as completion, weaken legality, or mark L2 PASS before retained-Rocket equivalence closes.
